title: Zaltic MC
description: Zaltic MC is a survival Minecraft server with a variety of features to keep things interesting.
body:
```
# Welcome to Zaltic MC! 🎮
**Survival · Factions · Community**

Zaltic MC is a feature-rich survival Minecraft server built around community, competition, and creativity. Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting out, there's something here for everyone.

---

## 🏃 Parkour Arena
Test your skills on our custom-built parkour course, designed to challenge players of all levels.

## 🛒 Player Shops
Set up your own shop and trade with the community. Build your economy, buy what you need, and sell what you've got.

## ⚔️ Factions
Form alliances, claim land, raid enemies, and dominate the server. Faction wars keep things competitive and exciting.

## ✨ Advanced Enchantments
Go beyond vanilla with a wide range of custom enchantments that add a whole new layer of depth to your gear and playstyle.

---

We're a growing and welcoming community always looking to expand. Jump in, make friends, and carve out your place in Zaltic MC.

📢 **Looking for Staff!** We're recruiting dedicated and passionate players to join our moderation team. Interested? DM **stanley.yelnats** on Discord.

🌐 **Server IP:** `193.237.142.205:25577`
```
